dc_vs_hand_solve.plan_case: DC node voltages against a hand-written Gaussian elimination
dc_vs_hand_solve.basis: double-precision direct solve of a well-conditioned system

dc_conservation.basis: charge conservation is exact for a lumped network

geometry_resistance.plan_case: Conductor resistance from geometry, R = rho L / A

tcr_vs_iec60751.basis: the observed deviation must equal the analytically predicted omitted quadratic term to within 5 percent of the prediction

iec60751_recitation.plan_case: expected_limitations: cross-validated against the standard's own published ratio W(100) = 1.3851
iec60751_recitation.basis: half of the last printed digit of the published figure, 0.00005/1.3851 = 3.61e-5 -- the same printed-precision rule the plan preregistered for ngspice

lumped_vs_rk4.plan_case: Lumped thermal transient against an independent RK4
lumped_vs_rk4.basis: RK4 at 200k steps on a linear scalar ODE reaches round-off

lumped_energy_balance.basis: the first law admits no tolerance beyond round-off

diffusion_error_ratio.basis: observed error divided by the error the declared scheme itself predicts

battery_algebra.plan_case: Battery state of charge, terminal voltage and runtime
battery_algebra.basis: exact algebra through a chain of milli-prefixed units

battery_charge_conservation.basis: relative, or below the cancellation floor 4 ulp(z0) eta Q when little charge moved

cstr_trajectory.plan_case: CSTR trajectory against an independent RK4
cstr_trajectory.basis: the oracle's own resolution, evidenced by a refinement ladder

cstr_steady_state_k.plan_case: CSTR steady states against a hand-written bisection
cstr_steady_state_k.basis: an algebraic route with no time integration

gas_constant.basis: admits the stored truncation of 1.8e-11 and refuses more

applicability_utilization.plan_case: not separately preregistered; the utilizations are exact algebra and are held to the same round-off band every other exact algebraic case in the plan is held to

peukert.plan_case: Battery state of charge, terminal voltage and runtime -- the same exact-algebra band, applied to the capacity derating in the same declaration

* divider -- emitted from the raw fixture
RR1 n1 n2 4700.0
RR2 n2 0 2200.0
VV1 n1 0 DC 12.0
.options reltol=1e-13 vntol=1e-13 abstol=1e-16 gmin=1e-15

op
print v(n1) v(n2)
print i(VV1)
.endc
.end

RR1 n1 0 3300.0
RR2 n1 n2 1000.0
RR3 n2 0 6800.0

.options reltol=1e-13 vntol=1e-13 abstol=1e-16 gmin=1e-15
.control
set numdgt=12
op
print v(n1) v(n2)
.endc
.end

RR1 n1 n2 1000.0

.control
set numdgt=12
op
print v(n1) v(n2) v(n3)
print i(VV1)
.endc
.end

* two_source_ladder -- emitted from the raw fixture
RR1 n1 n2 1500.0
RR2 n2 n3 2700.0
RR3 n3 0 5600.0

.end
